# bdk-skill-kit - the bdk-skill-kit plugin

::: v-pre

Check Agent Skills and Claude Code agent files with a deterministic validator that explains every rule

## Skills

### `/bdk-skill-kit:skill-check` {#skill-check}

`/bdk-skill-kit:skill-check`

Started by: you, or Claude when your request matches the description below.

Validates Agent Skills directories and agent files with deterministic rules - frontmatter, size, references, layout and CLI-fronting skills. Use when a skill or an agent is about to be committed, after each iteration of a skill being written, or when CI reports a skill-check finding.

:::
